testcase.name: Scenario: Keep a panel hidden when redocking the floating ribbon: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/panel-visibility-snapshot/checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:114:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Keep a panel hidden when redocking the floating ribbon ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the floating 3D Model ribbon shows the Modify group ✔ When the user hides Modify through Show Panels ✔ Then the floating ribbon no longer shows the Modify group ✔ When the user docks the ribbon at the top ✔ Then the top ribbon does not show the Modify panel ✔ When the user opens Show Panels on the top ribbon ✔ Then Modify is unchecked ✔ When the user selects Modify ✔ Then the Modify panel is visible again
